t021.sum: The Ancients of Days are twenty-one supreme rulers of Paradise Trinity origin who, in groups of three, each govern one of the seven superuniverses. They alone render the final executive verdicts on the eternal life and death of will creatures, and by the technique of reflectivity they see and hear at once Paradise above and the local universes below. They are the summit of the superuniverse government that mortals meet on their ascension journey after graduating from the local universe.
t021.s1.i1: The Ancients of Days are the third of the seven orders of Supreme Trinity Personalities; their number is fixed, and no more are coming into being.
t021.s1.i3: The Seven Master Spirits differ in nature, but the Ancients of Days, though possessing individuality, are uniform and superperfect offspring of the Trinity.
t021.s1.i4: All twenty-one were trinitized at the same time, and the very first entry in the personality records of Paradise is the recital of their trinitization.
t021.s1.i6: Beings of Trinity origin are in no danger of failure or rebellion, and these rulers have never deviated from the path of perfect personality conduct.
t021.s2.i2: In high administration the three always act together; though they never leave their headquarters world, its position as the focus of the reflectivity system leaves their rule unhindered.
t021.s2.i3: While the Master Spirits determine the nature of a superuniverse, the Ancients of Days determine its administration, providing uniform rule over otherwise differing superuniverses.
t021.s2.i4: They are assisted by the Perfectors of Wisdom, Divine Counselors, and Universal Censors, and by Trinitized Sons drawn from glorified ascendant mortals.
t021.s2.i5: The observations and recommendations gathered by the rulers of the major and minor sectors rise step by step until at last they reach the courts of the Ancients of Days.
t021.s3.h: The Final Judgment of Eternal Life and Death
t021.s3.i1: They are the most powerful of the direct rulers of the time-space creations, and they alone have the power to pass final sentence on the eternal extinction of will creatures.
t021.s3.i3: When the restoring love of the Creator Sons is finally rejected, the sentence of extinction is carried out by forces under their jurisdiction.
t021.s3.i5: There is no appeal from the verdicts of a superuniverse, for they are the united opinion of the Ancients of Days and of the Master Spirit presiding over that superuniverse.
t021.s3.i7: They and their associates of Trinity origin render the righteous judgments of supreme equity throughout the seven superuniverses.
t021.s4.h: The Reflective Rule That Sees and Hears All
t021.s4.i2: The primary seconaphim serve as living mirrors, reflecting before them the minds and voices of the Infinite Spirit, the Creator Sons, and the angelic hosts.
t021.s4.i3: They infer the Father's will by harmonizing the voice of spirit from above with the voices of the Michaels below, and because this requires all three together, a superuniverse is always presided over by three.
t021.s4.i4: The superuniverses are isolated from one another, and direct personal communication with the rulers of another superuniverse must go through the Solitary Messengers.
t021.s5.h: Relation to the Local Universes, and the Future
t021.s5.i1: A Creator Son pledges to the Trinity not to assume full sovereignty until his seven creature bestowals have been certified by the Ancients of Days.
t021.s5.i2: They do not certify a Creator Son as universe sovereign until he has actually lived as a creature and gained the creature's point of view.
t021.s5.i3: At Michael's petition they authorized the detention of the personalities involved in the Lucifer rebellion, and the final disposition of the archrebels remains in their hands.
t021.s5.i4: Since their prerogatives of rule were not earned by experience, they will someday be superseded by the Supreme Being, the experiential sovereign, and become his vicegerents.
t021.s5.i5: The mortal's journey of finding God begins with the Creator Son and proceeds through the Ancients of Days and the Master Spirit of the superuniverse to the Universal Father.
t022.sum: A Creator Son is a primary Paradise Son, born of the Universal Father and the Eternal Son together, who designs, creates, and rules a local universe. The creator of our universe of Nebadon is Michael, who earned his sovereignty experientially by bestowing himself seven times in the likeness of his creatures, his final bestowal being the life he lived on Urantia as Jesus of Nazareth. To us he is, for all practical purposes, God, and the way by which the Father is revealed.
t022.s1.i1: A Creator Son is a being of dual origin, born in a flash when the Father's absolute concept of personality and the Eternal Son's absolute spiritual idea are perfectly united.
t022.s1.i3: Michael of Nebadon is the 611,121st personalization of an original concept of infinite identity, and he shows characteristics more like those of the Eternal Son.
t022.s1.i4: Michael is not a member of the Paradise Trinity, yet in his universe he possesses all the divine attributes and powers the Eternal Son would have if present.
t022.s2.i1: Before choosing his space site, a Creator Son spends long periods observing and learning from the creations of his elder brothers in the same superuniverse.
t022.s2.i2: When he leaves Paradise he is accompanied by a Creative Daughter of the Infinite Spirit, who later personalizes as the local universe Mother Spirit.
t022.s2.i3: New modifications of energy-matter require the consent of the Infinite Spirit, and new designs of creatures that of the Eternal Son, while personality is bestowed by the Father alone.
t022.s2.i4: Because creators differ, the life forms of the local universes they design are each original.
t022.s2.i5: When Michael is absent, Gabriel, the Bright and Morning Star, directs the universe, and the Mother Spirit supervises in place of his spiritual presence.
t022.s3.i1: A Creator Son could claim sovereignty from the beginning, but he pledges to the Trinity not to assume supreme sovereignty until he has completed seven bestowals.
t022.s3.i3: In his seven bestowals he penetrates seven levels of creature life, revealing one by one the sevenfold will of Deity as personalized in the Seven Master Spirits.
t022.s3.i5: Having completed his bestowals, a Creator Son becomes a Master Son, and the addition of creature experience to his nature brings about a permanent change.
t022.s4.i1: After six bestowals, Michael came down to Urantia in the likeness of mortal flesh, the lowest of will creatures.
t022.s4.i2: The final bestowal went beyond earning sovereignty; it was a plan for the supreme revelation of submission to the will of the Universal Father.
t022.s4.i5: Because his death on Urantia completed his bestowal career, he could truly say, "It is finished."
t022.s4.i6: And so this little planet, the mortal home of the sovereign Christ Michael, has become the sentimental shrine of all Nebadon.
t022.s5.h: The Rule and Destiny of the Master Son
t022.s5.i1: After the Urantia bestowal, Michael was acknowledged by the Ancients of Days and the Universal Father as the settled sovereign of Nebadon.
t022.s5.i2: When the Mother Spirit subordinated herself to him, Michael became the personal repository of divinity, with all power in heaven and on earth.
t022.s5.i3: The Master Son pours out the Spirit of Truth "upon all flesh" and so communicates unceasingly with the worlds where he has sojourned.
t022.s5.i4: The sum of the seven bestowals is a new Nebadon revelation of the Supreme Being, and it has also augmented the sovereignty of the evolving God the Supreme.
t022.s5.i5: The Michaels are believed to be destined to become, in eternity, literally "the way, the truth, and the life."
t023.sum: The local universe Mother Spirit is the Creative Daughter individualized by the Infinite Spirit for each local universe, the co-ordinate companion who builds the universe, brings forth life, and rules together with the Creator Son. In Nebadon she is called the Divine Minister, and through the breath of life, the seven adjutant mind-spirits, and the Holy Spirit she bestows mind and spirit on all creatures. As Michael functions as a father, she fills the role of a mother, never coercing but gently leading men along the path of sonship.
t023.s1.h: The Local Universe Daughter of the Infinite Spirit
t023.s1.i1: When a Creator Son is personalized, the Infinite Spirit individualizes a new and unique representation of himself to go out into space with him as his companion.
t023.s1.i2: The Universe Mother Spirits receive prepersonal training on the worlds of Havona, learning to co-operate with the Paradise Sons under the will of the Father.
t023.s1.i4: The Mother Spirit of Nebadon is the 611,121st of the sixth group of Supreme Spirits, and she has created and governed this universe together with Michael.
t023.s1.i5: When a Creator Son departs for space, the Universal Father's proclamation of the eternal union of the two is one of the most touching events on Paradise.
t023.s2.i1: When Michael proclaims the creation of life, a "primary eruption" occurs on Paradise, and at that moment the Creative Spirit becomes a personal being, the Divine Minister.
t023.s2.i2: The personalized Mother Spirit acquires a personal nature tinged with the nature of the Master Spirit who presides over that superuniverse.
t023.s2.i3: In the stage of physical creation, the Universe Son provides the pattern and the Universe Spirit materializes these energy creations into physical substance.
t023.s2.i4: When Michael returned from his seventh bestowal, the Mother Spirit pledged her subordination to him, and Michael established her as coruler.
t023.s2.i6: This "Proclamation of Equality" is the transcendent pattern for family organization and government and the high ideal of the human home and voluntary marriage.
t023.s3.h: Mother of Life and of Spirit Personalities
t023.s3.i1: When the Life Carriers have prepared the physical bodies, the Universe Spirit contributes "the breath of life," activating the lifeless patterns and imparting the power of reproduction.
t023.s3.i2: Michael and the Mother Spirit are literally the father-son and spirit-mother of all native creatures of Nebadon.
t023.s3.i4: The seraphim were created as the first solitary spirit reproduction of the Mother Spirit, and her creative activity never ceases as Nebadon grows.
t023.s3.i5: When rebellion arises only the Son can act as savior, but the Spirit always sustains him in all that he undergoes.
t023.s4.i2: The seven adjutant mind-spirits are created by the Divine Minister and are called the spirits of wisdom, worship, counsel, knowledge, courage, understanding, and intuition.
t023.s4.i3: As soon as a mind reaches the level of receiving the adjutants of worship and wisdom, it is included in the spirit circuit of the Divine Minister, the ministry of the Holy Spirit.
t023.s4.i4: The Mother Spirit never leaves Salvington, and because she is fixed there the Spirit of Truth functions independently of Michael's whereabouts.
t023.s4.i6: The joint presence of the Holy Spirit, the Spirit of Truth, and the Adjuster in one mortal is a symmetry of spiritual endowment that brings consciousness of sonship with God.
t023.s5.h: The Spirit at Work in Man
t023.s5.i2: The ministry of the Holy Spirit is partly independent of man's attitude, but the more fully man follows divine leading, the more effective it becomes in sanctifying the inner life.
t023.s5.i4: Between the animal nature and spiritual urges, the combined spirits help man throughout life to subject the flesh increasingly to the leading of the spirit.
t024.sum: The Melchizedek Sons are the first-born order of the local universe, brought forth by the Creator Son, the Mother Spirit, and the Father Melchizedek together. Standing midway between the highest Divinity and the lowest creature life, they can serve the evolutionary races without incarnation, working as universe teachers, as the pattern of self-government, and as emergency Sons who are first to act in any crisis. Ascending mortals are taught by them all the way from the mansion worlds to the Melchizedek University on Salvington.
t024.s1.h: The First-Born Sons of the Local Universe
t024.s1.i1: From a new creative union of the Creator Son and the Creative Spirit the Father Melchizedek came first, and in co-operation with the two creators he brought this entire order into being.
t024.s1.i2: The Melchizedeks of Nebadon were all created within one thousand years of standard time; theirs is a nonreproducing order numbering more than ten million.
t024.s1.i4: So they become the natural intermediaries between higher divine existence and material life, the friends, teachers, and counselors of all intelligent beings.
t024.s1.i5: The Father Melchizedek, Gabriel's first executive associate, presides over the emergency commissions and functions as chief executive of Nebadon in Gabriel's absence.
t024.s2.h: An Order of Self-Government and Trust
t024.s2.i1: The Melchizedeks are a self-governing order that elects its own administrative heads, the first attempt at self-determination on the part of local universe beings.
t024.s2.i3: They patrol the universe on their own, reporting to the Creator Son independently of the regular agencies, and they also function as advisory review courts that travel among the worlds.
t024.s2.i5: In the Lucifer rebellion all the Melchizedeks remained loyal to Michael, and on Panoptia the entire population, under their leadership, stood with Michael.
t024.s3.i1: The sphere Melchizedek, the pilot world of the Salvington circuit, and its associated worlds are called the Melchizedek University, and every ascending mortal passes through its training.
t024.s3.i3: The progressive education of ascending mortals in the morontia career is conducted under the general supervision of the Melchizedeks, in association with the Trinity Teacher Sons.
t024.s3.i4: The Melchizedeks lead the great teaching corps of the mansion worlds, helping souls continue there the attainments they failed to achieve in the life in the flesh.
t024.s3.i5: On Jerusem they conduct more than thirty educational centers, training ascending mortals in schools of administration to take up representative government.
t024.s4.i2: They are the first to act in any emergency, sometimes serving as temporary custodians of wayward planets or as receivers for planetary governments that have defaulted.
t024.s4.i3: Seven times in Nebadon a Melchizedek has served an evolutionary world in the likeness of mortal flesh, Melchizedek of Salem in the days of Abraham being one of them.
t024.s4.i4: When an Avonal Son goes on a bestowal, twelve Melchizedeks accompany him as sponsors, and they also assist the Avonals on magisterial missions.
t024.s4.i5: The Melchizedeks co-operate with the Life Carriers in reviewing the life plans of new worlds, and the chief of Melchizedeks often represents the Creator Son.
t024.s5.i1: After the rebellion of the Planetary Prince, Urantia was administered for a long time by a council of twelve Melchizedek receivers.
t024.s5.i2: The Melchizedek receivers warned Adam and Eve of the dangers of the rebel prince, and about seven years after Adam's arrival they turned over the world administration to him.
t024.s5.i3: In his first bestowal Michael appeared as a stranger Melchizedek Son and shared in the emergency service of this order.
t024.s5.i5: It is believed that the Melchizedeks are destined to remain in their universe of origin and to take an increasingly important part in local universe government and administration.
t025.sum: The Avonal Sons, or Magisterial Sons, are the second order of Paradise Sons, issuing from the Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit. On the evolutionary worlds they serve as judges of dispensations, as magistrates who raise a planetary age one step higher, and as bestowal Sons born of woman who live as mortals. Through these "lesser Christs," fully backed by the power of the Creator Son, nearly all inhabited worlds receive the Spirit of Truth and the Thought Adjusters, yet Urantia has never received a magisterial mission.
t025.s1.h: The Second Order of Paradise Sons
t025.s1.i1: Whenever an absolute concept of the Eternal Son unites with a new ideal of loving service of the Infinite Spirit, a new Paradise Magisterial Son appears.
t025.s1.i2: The Magisterial Sons of the grand universe are estimated at about one billion; they are directed by the supreme council of Paradise and, once assigned to a local universe, serve under the Creator Son.
t025.s1.i5: While the Creator Sons reveal the character of the Father, the Avonals, Sons of merciful bestowal, reveal the nature of the Eternal Son with his infinite compassion.
t025.s2.i1: The Avonals are the magistrates of the realms who awaken the sleeping survivors, terminate a dispensation, and reassign the planetary ministers to the tasks of the new age.
t025.s2.i3: On "technical" visits made solely for dispensational judgment they do not incarnate but come as spiritual beings invisible to material creatures.
t025.s2.i4: The closing roll call of a dispensation is proclaimed by the archangel attending the Avonal, and the seraphic guardians of the sleepers respond to that "voice of the archangel."
t025.s2.i5: Even on worlds settled in light and life their judicial acts continue, but they then become formal, not altering the course of planetary events.
t025.s3.i1: World peace, with racial strife and national hostility gone, is the sign that a planet is mature enough to receive a Magisterial Son.
t025.s3.i2: On the first magisterial mission the Avonal incarnates without birth as a full-grown adult of the race, appearing as one whom men can see and touch.
t025.s3.i4: Soon after the first visit of a Magisterial Son, mankind attains economic liberation, the daily labor needed for self-support falling to about two and one-half hours.
t025.s3.i5: If one magisterial mission does not prepare the world for a bestowal Son, a second or later Magisterial Son comes and advances mankind one age at a time.
t025.s4.i1: Every Avonal bestows himself at least once upon some mortal race, and on each planet only one bestowal Son appears, born of woman.
t025.s4.i3: A Magisterial Son always bestows himself not subject to the Father's will but subject to the will of the Eternal Son of Paradise.
t025.s4.i4: Bestowal Sons must die, but a violent death is not required by the divine plan, and most worlds treat them more considerately.
t025.s4.i6: When an Avonal who has completed his bestowal and the Creator Son together send forth the Spirit of Truth, the normal will creatures of that world receive Thought Adjusters.
t025.s5.i1: On planetary missions the Avonals are aided by Melchizedeks and archangels, and on bestowal missions they are accompanied by Brilliant Evening Stars and a bestowal retinue of 144.
t025.s5.i2: After usually seven missions an Avonal yields the opportunity to other Sons and joins in universe administration in the high councils of the Creator Son.
t025.s5.i4: The bestowal Son of Urantia was not an Avonal but Michael himself, though any bestowal Son would have been equally adequate for spiritual rehabilitation.
t025.s5.i5: Since the world of Michael's bestowal is a ward of the Master Son, only time will reveal when a Magisterial Son will come to Urantia.
t026.sum: The Trinity Teacher Sons, or Daynals, are Sons who come directly from the Paradise Trinity and, together with the Creator Sons and the Magisterial Sons, make up the third order of Paradise Sons. They neither rule nor judge; they are the educators of the universes, dedicated to the moral enlightenment and spiritual awakening of mortals and spirit beings alike. On the evolutionary worlds they carry out the last divine mission, opening a spiritual age that leads a planet into the era of light and life.
t026.s1.i1: These Sons were brought into being by the Paradise Trinity; they are called Daynals in Havona, Trinity Teacher Sons in Orvonton, and Paradise Spiritual Sons on Salvington.
t026.s1.i3: Trinity in origin yet serving in the ministry of divine sonship, they hold a dual status as liaison beings between personalities of Trinity origin and those of dual origin.
t026.s1.i4: Unlike the stationary Sons of the Trinity, whose number is fixed, the Teacher Sons keep increasing; the reported number is a little over twenty-one billion, with large reserves on Paradise besides.
t026.s1.i5: They share the combined natures of the three Deities, yet in Havona they seem to reflect more of the Father, in the superuniverses the Eternal Son, and in the local creations the Infinite Spirit.
t026.s2.h: Sons Who Teach Rather Than Rule
t026.s2.i1: They are neither creators nor retrievers, neither judges nor rulers, and so are not an organic part of the local or superuniverse governments.
t026.s2.i3: They are sent directly to the superuniverse headquarters without preliminary training in the central universe, and having no spirit drawing power of their own, they use the spiritual influence of the Creator Sons and Magisterial Sons.
t026.s2.i4: They begin their ministry in the local systems, advance through the constellations to the highest work of the local creation, and are equally concerned with educating mortals and native local universe beings such as the seraphim.
t026.s2.i5: They are the faculty in charge of the qualifying tests and examinations for the lower stages of universe service, directing training courses from planetary schools up to the high colleges of wisdom on Salvington.
t026.s2.i6: The educational system of Nebadon is jointly administered by the Teacher Sons and the Melchizedek teaching corps, and the whole universe is described as one vast school.
t026.s2.i7: They adopt creature-trinitized sons as apprentices, train them, and may nominate them for the embrace of the Trinity.
t026.s3.h: Opening a Spiritual Age on a Planet
t026.s3.i1: They have nothing to do with ending dispensations or judging the dead; they are wholly concerned with bringing the dawn of the era of spiritual realities to an evolutionary planet.
t026.s3.i3: A planetary Teacher Son is assisted by seventy primary Sons, twelve secondary Sons, and three of the supreme order, and the corps remains for not less than a thousand years of planetary time.
t026.s3.i5: Since they do not materialize to become visible to mortals, the Brilliant Evening Stars serve as liaison between the unseen corps of Teacher Sons and the mortals of the world.
t026.s3.i6: In this age many mortals are translated from among the living, and as Adjuster fusion increases, natural death becomes less and less frequent.
t026.s4.h: Urantia and the Future of Light and Life
t026.s4.i1: Having never passed through a spiritual age, Urantia is unfamiliar with these Sons, but Teacher Sons even now visit the world to plan their future sojourn.
t026.s4.i2: They will appear after the inhabitants of this world have become relatively free from the shackles of animalism and the fetters of materialism.
t026.s4.i3: No one knows whether the second coming promised by Jesus will come before or after the appearance of a Magisterial Son or of the Teacher Sons.
t026.s4.i4: At the end of one of their repeated missions the Planetary Prince is elevated to the status of Planetary Sovereign, and the System Sovereign proclaims the opening of the era of light and life.
t026.s4.i6: It is believed on Uversa that the Teacher Sons, long associated with the lives of evolutionary mortals, will be eternally united with the Corps of the Finality when the superuniverse is settled in light and life.
t026.s5.h: The Co-operation of the Three Paradise Sons
t026.s5.i1: The Creator Sons reveal the character of the Father, the Avonals the mercy of the Eternal Son, and the Daynals the teaching personality of the Infinite Spirit; together they realize the sovereignty of God the Supreme.
t026.s5.i3: The Teacher Sons are the supreme co-ordinating personalities of Trinity origin; in the vast universe there is always great danger of narrow viewpoints and fragmented concepts of reality.
t027.sum: The seraphim are angels created by the local universe Mother Spirit, and with the cherubim and sanobim they form the corps of ministering spirits of the local universe. Though without material bodies, they are spirit beings with individual personalities who understand and love human beings. Divided into seven orders, from supreme seraphim to future seraphim, they assist in almost every task of the local universe: administration, education, transport, records, and planetary supervision. They themselves are ascending beings, destined to reach Paradise by way of Seraphington.
t027.s1.i1: Seraphim are created by projection of the Universe Mother Spirit, 41,472 at a time, and since Nebadon is still in the making, they continue to be created periodically.
t027.s1.i2: As the supernaphim serve the central universe and the seconaphim the superuniverses, so in the local universe the seraphim, together with the cherubim and sanobim, make up the angelic hosts.
t027.s1.i4: They are fully aware of human moral struggles and spiritual difficulties, enjoy music, art, and real humor, and love human beings.
t027.s1.i5: Though not sex creatures, they are deeply affectionate; they live in pairs of negative and positive beings and carry out most of their assignments two by two.
t027.s1.i7: It is well to love the angels, but they are not to be worshiped; they are fellow servants with man in the worship of God.
t027.s2.i1: They spend their first millennium as observers in the schools of Salvington and the second on the seraphic worlds, then pass through the constellation and system before being commissioned as ministering spirits of time.
t027.s2.i3: From groups of twelve pairs they are organized into companies, battalions, units, legions, hosts, and angelic armies, each twelve times larger, and the armies are commanded by Brilliant Evening Stars and others.
t027.s2.i4: The "more than twelve legions of angels" that Jesus spoke of in Gethsemane refers to these very legion units of seraphim.
t027.s2.i5: Since Michael's bestowal on Urantia, the seraphim and all local universe orders have come under the sovereignty of the Master Son.
t027.s2.i6: The cherubim and sanobim, of the same origin as the seraphim, are the lowest order of angels; working in pairs, they are the faithful aids of the seraphim.
t027.s3.h: The Seven Orders and Their Work
t027.s3.i1: The revealed seraphim are divided into seven orders: supreme, superior, supervisor, administrator, planetary helpers, transition ministers, and seraphim of the future.
t027.s3.i3: Transport seraphim enseraphim ascenders and carry them from world to world; the one so enfolded sleeps for a set time and awakens at the destination.
t027.s3.i4: The social architects among the supervisor seraphim foster genuine social contacts and help bring about efficient and harmonious working groups.
t027.s3.i5: The moral advisers among the administrator seraphim teach the interplay of liberty and loyalty and portray mortal life as the first link in a long and unbroken chain.
t027.s3.i7: The transition ministers foster the morontia progress of survivors on the mansion worlds and are among the seraphim who come closest to human beings.
t027.s4.i1: Even after the failure of the Adamic regime, the spirits of brotherhood, the souls of peace, and the spirits of trust among the planetary helpers continue their work on Urantia.
t027.s4.i2: The idea that angels have wings derives largely from traditions of ancient observations of seraphim preparing for transport.
t027.s4.i3: With the outpouring of the Spirit of Truth came the twelve legions of master seraphim of planetary supervision, caring for epochs, progress, religion, nations, races, education, health, the home, industry, diversion, and more.
t027.s4.i4: While the angels of progress promote new advances, the religious guardians carry the immortal values within older forms to the next generation, and so the two balance each other.
t027.s5.i1: Seraphim may reach Paradise by several paths, among them the perfect attainment of specialized service, summons to Seraphington, and the guardianship of evolutionary mortals.
t027.s5.i2: Angels are not certain of their eternal future until they reach Seraphington, and no angel who has attained Seraphington is known ever to have gone astray.
t027.s5.i3: Cherubim and sanobim, too, may be reborn as full seraphim after long service and repeated embraces of the Universe Mother Spirit.
t027.s5.i4: Many paths open to completion seraphim, but they most desire to serve as bestowal attendants of incarnated Paradise Sons.
t028.sum: Guardian seraphim are the seraphim who watch over individual mortals. When a person reaches the third circle, makes the supreme decision to become like God, or enters the reserve corps of destiny, a personal guardian, a guardian of destiny, is assigned. They work through outward circumstances without invading the human will; after death they hold the survival values of the soul, help with repersonalization on the mansion worlds, and accompany the ascender on the upward career. For seraphim this assignment is the surest way to Paradise.
t028.s1.i2: Since Michael's bestowal, seraphim are assigned not according to race but according to the intellect, spirituality, and destiny of human beings.
t028.s1.i3: Ordinary people are cared for by guardian seraphim according to circle attainment: in groups of one thousand in the seventh circle, five hundred in the sixth, one hundred in the fifth, and ten in the fourth.
t028.s1.i4: On reaching the third circle, a personal angel (actually two) is devoted wholly to that mortal.
t028.s1.i5: When a person is enrolled in the reserve corps of destiny or makes the supreme decision, a true betrothal with the Adjuster, a personal guardian is assigned at once, whatever the circle.
t028.s1.i6: For reservists chosen as guardians of planetary destiny, the chief of planetary seraphim appoints personal guardians of destiny.
t028.s2.i1: Seraphim are not called guardians of destiny until the human has made the supreme decision, entered the third circle, or been mustered into the reserve corps of destiny.
t028.s2.i2: The first mortal on Urantia to receive a personal guardian was Rantowoc, a wise man of the red race, long ago.
t028.s2.i3: Assignments are always made from volunteers among experienced and tested seraphim, and more than a hundred seraphim have applied for the guardianship of a single person.
t028.s2.i4: One of the pair is always on duty, while the complement acts as the person's recording angel, and the records are kept by the associated cherubim and sanobim.
t028.s2.i5: Seraphim crave equally to attend an incarnated Son and to be attached as guardians of destiny, the latter being the surest passport to Paradise.
t028.s2.i6: Angels feel lasting affection for their human associates, yet they find it hard to understand the animal fears that dominate even human faith.
t028.s3.i1: The guardian personally co-ordinates the many impersonal influences of the Infinite Spirit and correlates them with the spirit presence of the Father and the Son.
t028.s3.i3: Whereas the Adjuster works from within through the soul, the seraphim act from without inward through the social, ethical, and moral environment of human beings.
t028.s3.i5: Accepting seraphic guidance does not make life easy; rather, one meets the rugged hills of moral choosing and spiritual progress.
t028.s3.i6: The prayer impulse of God-conscious persons often arises from seraphic influence, and the guardian is most active when the Adjuster is least active.
t028.s4.h: A Ministry That Respects the Human Will
t028.s4.i2: Seraphim have no physical tears, bodies, or wings, yet they experience spiritual emotions somewhat like human feelings.
t028.s4.i3: They do not respond directly to prayers but act on the orders of their superiors, and so they function independently of human whims and moods.
t028.s4.i5: When a person charts his own course, the angels help make the best possible use of it, intervening only in emergencies and then usually on the orders of their superiors.
t028.s5.h: After Death and the Ascending Career
t028.s5.i1: At death the guardian preserves the person's records, identity specifications, and the morontia reality of the soul, and awaits the awakening of its ward on the first mansion world.
t028.s5.i3: Those of the lower circles who had no personal guardian are reassembled by group guardians in the resurrection halls of the mansion spheres at the end of a dispensation.
t028.s5.i4: Every mortal acquires a permanent guardian before leaving the mansion worlds, and that guardian stays until the ascender is enseconaphimed for the departure to Havona.
t028.s5.i6: Only pairs of guardians of destiny attain spiritual unity and enter the primary, or mortal, Corps of the Finality, becoming the eternal companions of human beings.
t029.sum: Midwayers, or midway creatures, are beings native to the planet who exist on a level midway between mortals and angels. On Urantia the primary midwayers came from the corporeal staff of Prince Caligastia, and the secondary midwayers from the unique children of Adamson and Ratta. Many went astray in the rebellion, but the loyal ones, as the United Midwayers, assist the seraphim and keep the memory of the planet; when the age of light and life arrives, they will set out on the Paradise career as ascending sons of God.
t029.s1.i1: They are called midway creatures because they function on a level of life between mortals and the angelic orders, and they appear on most inhabited planets and on all decimal planets.
t029.s1.i2: They are not an accident of evolution but an essential part of a plan foreordained by the universe architects and designed by the Life Carriers.
t029.s1.i3: They have a threefold classification: ascending sons by origin, virtually permanent citizens in fact, and numbered with the ministering spirits of time in function.
t029.s2.i2: Permission was granted to the couples of Prince Caligastia's corporeal staff, and the first fifty were born, followed in time by the original corps of fifty thousand.
t029.s2.i3: As the intelligence corps of the Prince's administration, they studied the races of the world and helped influence human societies far from headquarters.
t029.s2.i4: In the planetary rebellion, 40,119 of the original fifty thousand joined the Caligastia secession.
t029.s2.i5: The loyal primary midwayers entered the service of the Melchizedek receivers, and their leader, the first 1-2-3, stood firm with Van and Amadon on the day of rebellion.
t029.s3.i1: The secondary midwayers came from the children of Adamson, eldest son of Adam and Eve, and Ratta, the last pure-line descendant of the Prince's staff.
t029.s3.i2: Sixteen unique children of Adamson, forming eight couples, each produced a secondary midwayer every seventy days, until they numbered 1,984 in all.
t029.s3.i4: After Adamson's death the secondary midwayers drifted without organization, and 873 of them who would not follow Michael's rule were interned with the Pentecost adjudication.
t029.s3.i5: Before Pentecost rebel midwayers could influence the minds of inferior mortals, but since the outpouring of the Spirit of Truth no disloyal spirit can invade the human mind.
t029.s4.h: The Service of the United Midwayers
t029.s4.i1: At present the two orders on Urantia function as one group of 10,992, governed alternately by the senior member of each order.
t029.s4.i2: They are nonmaterial beings who neither sleep nor reproduce, yet they can enjoy human humor and follow human worship.
t029.s4.i3: Organized as midway messengers, planetary sentinels, contact personalities, and progress helpers, they serve with the planetary seraphim.
t029.s4.i4: Secondary midwayers can make physical contact with material things, and many of the literal phenomena ascribed to angels were their work.
t029.s4.i5: Today their chief task is to be the unrecognized associates of the men and women who make up the reserve corps of destiny.
t029.s5.h: Permanent Citizens of the Planet and Their Destiny
t029.s5.i2: They have pledged not to leave the planet until released by the universe authorities, and they remain on the planet until the age of light and life.
t029.s5.i4: Urantia civilization is the joint product of mortals and midwayers, and the gap between the two cultural levels will not be bridged before the age of light and life.
t029.s5.i5: When the planet reaches light and life, both groups are released from planetary service, enrolled as ascending sons of God, and begin the Paradise ascent with their earthly brethren.
t029.s5.i6: All the secondary midwayers eventually fuse with Adjusters and are mustered into the mortal Corps of the Finality.
t030.sum: The Life Carriers are local universe Sons created jointly by the Creator Son, the Universe Mother Spirit, and one of the Ancients of Days; they design creature life, plant it on the planets, and foster its evolution. The spark of life is given through them, but its essential factor comes from the Universe Mother Spirit, and their manipulations end once beings with will appear. Urantia is a life-modification world, and its life was newly formulated right here on the planet.
t030.s1.i1: The Life Carriers are the offspring of the Creator Son, the Universe Mother Spirit, and one designated Ancient of Days; they are the only group of intelligent life in the local universe in whose creation the superuniverse rulers take part.
t030.s1.i3: After creating three orders of sons, including the Melchizedeks, the Son and Spirit of the local universe co-operate with the next level of God the Sevenfold to produce the Life Carriers.
t030.s1.i4: One hundred million have been created in Nebadon, directed by the life-determining trio of Gabriel, the Father Melchizedek, and Nambia, the first-born Life Carrier.
t030.s1.i5: They are divided into three groups: senior Life Carriers, assistants, and custodians; a corps sent to a planet usually consists of one hundred seniors, one hundred assistants, and one thousand custodians.
t030.s1.i6: They can function on three levels: the physical level of electrochemistry, the intermediate level of quasi-morontia existence, and the semispiritual level.
t030.s2.i2: On the seven Life Carrier worlds of the Salvington circuit they study life planning, conservation, evolution, life associated with mind, and more; the original life designs are provided by the Creator Son.
t030.s2.i4: They formulate the life plasm, but the energy spark that enlivens the body and presages the mind comes from the Universe Mother Spirit.
t030.s2.i5: In imparting life they transmit nothing of their personal natures; as living catalytic presences they merely initiate the essential revolutions of matter.
t030.s3.i1: About half a million years of planetary time are allowed for establishing life on a new world; when that period ends, nothing new may be added.
t030.s3.i2: Until moral beings appear they may manipulate the environment to favor evolution, but they are not permitted to interfere mechanically or arbitrarily with the evolutionary process.
t030.s3.i4: When beings of will appear, their work is ended, and they must either leave the planet or take renunciation oaths to influence evolution no further.
t030.s3.i5: Two senior Life Carriers and twelve custodians remain on Urantia even now as advisers, under renunciation oaths.
t030.s3.i6: Since life cannot be made to unfold faster than the physical development of the planet, the Life Carriers must wait upon geologic evolution.
t030.s4.i1: Urantia is a decimal planet, a life-modification world, where the Life Carriers attempted to modify and improve the standard life designs.
t030.s4.i3: Because Urantia protoplasm was planned to function only in a salt solution, implantation waited until the sea waters had become sufficiently salty.
t030.s4.i4: Five hundred and fifty million years ago the corps of Life Carriers returned and made three marine-life implantations in the sheltered tropical inlets of the central sea between the separating continents.
t030.s4.i5: The chemical formula for wound healing was chosen after more than half a million experiments, showing that human life was intelligently planned.
t030.s4.i6: Urantia is the only planet in Satania where human-type will appeared in a race earlier than the colored races.
t030.s5.i1: The seven adjutant mind-spirits always accompany the Life Carriers to a new planet, and their central focus is located on the headquarters world of the Life Carriers.
t030.s5.i3: The experimental forms of life they organize on the Salvington worlds are always without reproductive ability.
t030.s5.i4: They know that life flows from the Father, through the Son, and by the Spirit, yet even they do not fully understand the nature and source of the life-activating spark.
t030.s5.i5: When the universe is settled in light and life, they expect to attain a fourth, wholly spiritual, stage of existence.
